notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms entry (WHT001) and statewide Division of Forestry context were found. Two web searches returned only TopoQuest place records for a Goulden Mountain summit in White County (about 1,519 ft in one, 1,325 ft in another). Those are not tower sources and were not used; the tnlandforms elevation of 1,529 ft is the one cited. No NHLR or FFLOS register page for this tower was found in the local cache. The MPS says TDF 'constructed' 208 towers ca. 1930 to ca. 1970 in one place and 'oversaw' 208 at its peak in another; the story uses the peak wording. The FFLA total of 275 built differs from the MPS peak of 208; the story says so and does not reconcile them.
